concerns.text: Verification relies on schemas (`estimation_result.schema.yaml`, `aggregated_metric.schema.yaml`) that are missing core fields required by the data model and FR-003 (e.g., `pooled_effect`, `ci_lower`, `ci_upper`, `estimator_type`). An implementer following the verification will produce scientifically invalid artifacts.

Contradictory naming for convergence indicators: T002 implements REML failure logic, but T003 mandates conformance to a schema using `reliability_flag` while the data model specifies `convergence_warning`.
The verification for T004 only checks record count (`jq length`), failing to verify the critical computational constraints (6h runtime, <7GB RAM) mandated by SC-003.
Task is too coarse; it combines the implementation of the generator, three different estimators, and the metrics calculation into a single task.
Task is too coarse; it combines the implementation of the visualization suite (`plots.py`) and the reporting engine (`report_gen.py`).
